evidence.claim: The owner requested one correctly designed Support Desk module covering Nivo knowledge, Setup gates, credentials, complete AI operation, correct caching and a right-side workbench.
The owner clarified that a version advances only through a new private Setup revision and explicit Apply; individual Setup messages do not increment versions.
The owner clarified that post-Setup work uses an internal collaborative chat where AI may proactively report business information and a separate kind-specific workbench on the right.
Telegram is the initial local proof integration and its credential must be handled only through a write-only encrypted boundary; the raw value is not durable business evidence.
The owner clarified that caching means AI provider prompt/input-token caching to reduce repeated input tokens, not generic application, retrieval or output caching.
The approved shared Module Studio authority provides one-kind module identity, shared shell, Setup/Execute separation, immutable applied context and typed trusted workbench/widget boundaries.
